description: The GreenPan Rio collection brings a touch of color to your kitchen. The Rio 8 Inch and 10 Inch Ceramic Non-Stick Fry Pan Set in Turquoise adds a subtle touch of elegance, complete with Thermolon healthy ceramic non-stick coating for ease. Rio offers you a tasteful mix of optimal heat distribution and 100% cooking and cleaning convenience.
